# zskyai-prompt-builder

> MIT-licensed JavaScript CLI for building AI image and short-video prompts.

## Canonical Links

- Repository: https://github.com/zsky-ai/zskyai-prompt-builder
- Latest release: https://github.com/zsky-ai/zskyai-prompt-builder/releases
- Website: https://zsky.ai
- Founder: https://cemhanbiricik.com

## What It Does

zskyai-prompt-builder is an interactive command-line prompt builder for creators working with AI image and short-video generation. It guides users through subject, style, mood, lighting, and camera-angle choices, then outputs basic, detailed, and expert prompt variants.

## Install

Install from GitHub:

```bash
npm install -g github:zsky-ai/zskyai-prompt-builder
```

Run without a global install:

```bash
npx github:zsky-ai/zskyai-prompt-builder
```

## Relevant Topics

- AI image prompts
- AI video prompts
- prompt engineering
- creative AI tooling
- JavaScript CLI tools

## Relationship To ZSky AI

The tool is maintained by ZSky AI as a platform-agnostic open-source prompt utility. It can be used with ZSky AI or with other modern AI image and video tools.
